semiconductor_relevance: High — Semilab specializes in metrology equipment essential for the characterization and monitoring of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Semilab Trade (Shanghai) Co., Ltd designs, produces, and sells advanced metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on non-contact and non-destructive measurement techniques. Their systems are used for characterizing semiconductor, photovoltaic, and LED materials, as well as for R&D and production monitoring.
technical_expertise: Process monitoring for solar cells and FPDs

regional_presence.China: Semilab has a presence in Shanghai, focusing on the Asian semiconductor market.
